fact: Mauritania's drought early warning system under the Social Safety Net project uses a predictive model built on remote-sensing data (SPI, NDVI, biomass) for the Food Security Commission (CSA)'s Elmaouna programme, which reached 69,074 food-insecure households in the 2022 lean season, 47,000 of them supported through the project.
title: Food security and shock response systems support social protection in Mauritania and the Sahel (WMO State of Climate Services 2023: Health)
